mira.name: V0.7 · Antares
whats_new: Apps that ask the phone for its ZTE feature values get the answer from the system, like stock.
The model chosen in Device profiles now reaches the apps.
Apps see the chip and CPU details of the chosen model family.
Every app sees the chosen GPU name, also in games.
CPU speed control and touch boost from Cube work like stock.
The SIM without mobile data has no empty space for arrows; the gap between the two SIMs is smaller.
About phone shows the build number as "V0.7 · Antares".
Every setting appears in one place only.
The Settings main page looks like the agreed preview.
Charging looks like stock: the RedMagic animation, the stock charging line on the lock screen, and the stock screen when charging with the phone off.
